name: cofemine-panel
description: Self-hosted Docker-first Minecraft server control panel

pnpm.//: Transitive-dependency security pins. These are all patch/minor bumps of packages we don't depend on directly (they arrive via dockerode, prisma, next, fastify), so they cannot be fixed by touching our own manifests. protobufjs matters most: it carries a code-injection advisory and rides into the agent — the container that holds docker.sock. Re-check with `pnpm audit` when bumping direct deps; drop an entry once the parent ships the fixed version itself.
